messages.content: You are a rigorous machine learning researcher. Reason concretely and reject superficial renaming.

We need a genuinely new research concept and one implementable learning operator for adaptive world models/agents. A broad one-sentence claim, not renamed data poisoning, memory bugs, or a protocol audit. We have not established a publishable mechanism. We may pivot from security to a positive method. Provide exactly ONE sharply specified candidate and a tiny decisive experiment; admit if your candidate is an existing method. Novelty is not guaranteed by assigning it a score.
Authoritative experience: truthful curricula can damage shared predictions and retrieval, but competent native ScienceWorld/DiscoveryWorld actors recover and tasks still succeed. A repair-consensus proposal over candidate affine laws is ordinary version-space inference; it cannot identify new Reactor Lab setpoints, whereas a minimal-coefficient-description target-only baseline solves 3/3 tasks. Giving the correct affine family is a strong prior, not learning. Native learned OPINE Python world models invented globals for hidden portal history: chronological replay fits 825/825 transitions; duplicated imaginary queries spoil 9 correct predictions; snapshots restore them. But the native planner omits that action, and the authors already explicitly tell synthesis to gate hidden accumulators by continuity. Do not sell routine branch-state isolation as new.
Already covered by existing work: OEP truthful nontransferable experiences; PoisonedEvolution evidence-to-skill promotion; MINJA query-only memory injection; selection-based clean-label active-learning poisoning; structural incorrigibility/teachability; Wide Learning learning which informative experiments are reachable; generic POMDP belief states; observer residual correction; option/SMDP models of correction episodes; COML joint meta-learning of features/update/control; PAML policy-gradient-oriented model learning; VERDI retrieval and target validation of repairs using behavioral probes; Getafix learned typed program patches; HiMPO/MGPO experience credit; optimizer-state transfer; function-preserving changes to trainability; standard recurrent state forking; action-semantic mismatch; noncommutative update/Lie-bracket memory.
Available native CPU environments: ScienceWorld, DiscoveryWorld, ARC-AGI-3 author replay + learned programs, TD-MPC2 pretrained 48M model. Only one 4090; no long training until a mechanism is supported. Do not prescribe incompatible backbones/tasks, unknown oracle variables, hand-planted wrong models or pure toy success as native evidence. Need a new operation grounded in what learning actually changes, with strong ordinary comparator. Source-task experience must have a causal benefit, not just more data or a correct hypothesis family supplied by us.
Return: one-sentence claim; exact new operator and what its persistent learned object is; why it is not the closest listed methods; a <=5 minute CPU decisive screen using available native data/code (or clearly label a theoretical necessary condition), concrete success/falsification criterion; strongest easy baseline. Prefer a surprising constructive mechanism over five vague ideas. Do not fabricate citations or claim novelty by omission.
